corrected_text: Agello's ChatEngine.makeEngine (a691212) creates the engine with the GPU main backend (the app has had no CPU backend since Agello 6db56c6, 2026-11-11), the CPU for vision and audio when enabled, maxNumTokens and a cache directory, and sets no activation data type, so LiteRT-LM applies the E4B file's prefer_activation_type fp16 (the same as its F16 default for the text executor) and the main graph runs with FP16 activations on the GPU.
note: Re-verified at Agello HEAD a691212 (read only).
